text: Frame.named/ephemeral and Grid.in/forFrame create live ephemeral owners with no persistent record. Persistent owners require caller-supplied FrameId/GridId. FrameKey owns id/rank/unit/convention; renameable FrameMetadata owns only label. GridKey owns id/full frame key/shape/canonical affine bytes and excludes validation tolerance. Registries are immutable values returning typed resolutions. Alignment proves common live or persistent identity; exact and explicit-tolerance grid congruence remain distinct relations.
